arguments.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset: one isolated full-body LILIPUTS.BMP game sprite. Image1 is the exact original for action, composition, silhouette, facing, limb paths, occlusion and every attached prop. Image2 is approved Cartoon worker IDENTITY AND MATERIAL ONLY, not its standing pose or its right-facing camera. FRAME088: Upright standing front-left three-quarter worker, head turned slightly LEFT with visible facial features and a natural partly visible far eye. Torso front readable. Both EMPTY arms spread outward: IMAGE LEFT hand is diagonally higher around shoulder/head level, IMAGE RIGHT hand lower around chest level, both palms open/upturned. Two straight legs with close separated feet. Rope is no longer held: preserve several separate loose golden cord segments on the lower-left and lower-right beside the feet. NO upright rope rising from either hand, no tool. Maintain an open empty-hand gesture, not the key's bent waist arm. Same worker identity: black cap, dark brown hair, tan skin, green long-sleeve shirt, royal blue bib overalls with simple gold buttons, dark charcoal shoes, crisp black outlines and restrained cel shading. Keep the frame-specific pose and head direction described above. Trace each arm from its shoulder through elbow to hand, and each leg from hip through knee to shoe, with natural joints and source occlusions. Do not duplicate a sleeve or add a third limb. Rope where present is flexible warm golden-yellow/tan cord with a thin dark contour, no glow; preserve its path and grip contacts. Keep all original props and entire figure safely inside the canvas with clear margins. Genuine RGBA transparent background, no scenery, floor plane, shadow, halo, text or extra props. Do not copy the reference key's generic upright standing pose.
